item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong public 2024 evidence of voluntary asset-declaration publication, campaign-finance disclosure, or a clear anti-nepotism rule that would independently constrain appointments.\nThe strongest pro-side items are mostly procedural or reactive: technocratic appointments, procurement reorganization, and the REA probe after fraud allegations became visible.\nThe strongest negative pattern is more specific and better documented: family-linked appointment to FHA, politically mediated palliative distribution, and repeated legal pressure on journalists investigating corruption or public-power abuse.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu Directs Reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"2024-06-15","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/","summary":"Tinubu ordered the BPP chief to resign as part of a reorganization “for greater efficiency and transparency,” which is direct counterevidence to a pure rent-seeking reading.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.7","7B.4"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: I have no Cabal or Sponsors to Compensate","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"2024-07-26","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-i-have-no-cabal-or-sponsors-to-compensate/","summary":"Tinubu publicly denied owing a cabal or sponsors and said his reform choices were not tied to factional repayment; this is only self-assertion, but it is relevant counterevidence against transactional politics.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.8","7B.4"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Appoints Management Team of the Nigerian Education Loan Fund","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"2024-04-05","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-management-team-of-the-nigerian-education-loan-fund/","summary":"The presidency described the NELFUND team as “qualified Nigerians,” presenting a merit/technocratic staffing pattern rather than a patronage pick.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.5","7B.4"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Appoints New Heads of Agencies and Programmes Under the Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"2024-08-06","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-heads-of-agencies-and-programmes-under-the-federal-ministry-of-humanitarian-affairs-disaster-management-and-social-management/","summary":"Tinubu appointed seven “qualified Nigerians” to humanitarian and social-development agencies; this is a positive signal for merit-based staffing, though still president-driven rather than arms-length.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.5","7B.4"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: Live Up To Your Expectation As Public Trust For Accountability","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"2024-07-06","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-live-up-to-your-expectation-as-public-trust-for-accountability/","summary":"Tinubu said public institutions are not personal enterprises and emphasized merit and accountability; this supports a pro-institution, anti-favoritism posture, but it is rhetoric.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.6","7B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria restarts cash transfers to cushion hardship caused by reforms","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"2024-02-26","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-restarts-cash-transfers-to-cushion-hardship-caused-by-reforms-46031196/","summary":"The government resumed direct cash transfers to 12 million vulnerable households, which is broader social protection rather than a narrow loyalty reward scheme.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.4","7B.8"]},{"title":"Posts mislead about ethnic links of new intelligence chiefs appointed by Nigerian president","publisher":"AFP Fact Check","date":"2024-09-04","url":"https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.36FF4M8","summary":"AFP found the “Yoruba-only” claim misleading; one appointee was Nupe, so the evidence cuts against a blanket ethnic-nepotism claim on this particular appointment set.","question_ids":["7B.9"]},{"title":"Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency","publisher":"BusinessDay","date":"2024-02-21","url":"https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/","summary":"Tinubu appointed his son-in-law to head the FHA; critics explicitly called it nepotism and a breach of office norms. This is the clearest family-favoritism evidence in the 2024 record.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.5","7B.4"]},{"title":"Reps blame agric ministry for delay in sharing Tinubu’s palliative","publisher":"The Guardian Nigeria","date":"2024-01-09","url":"https://guardian.ng/news/reps-blame-agric-ministry-for-delay-in-sharing-tinubus-palliative/","summary":"Rice palliatives were released to lawmakers for distribution to constituents, creating a discretionary and politically exposed channel that is vulnerable to patronage-style allocation.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.4","7B.8"]},{"title":"Tinubu govt prioritises inclusive palliative distribution — Maryam Shettima","publisher":"The Guardian Nigeria","date":"2024-09-17","url":"https://guardian.ng/news/tinubu-govt-prioritises-inclusive-palliative-distribution-maryam-shettima/","summary":"Even a defense of the distribution regime centers on a presidential committee and political appointee-managed mechanism, which still leaves the process highly mediated and opaque.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting","publisher":"CPJ","date":"2024-10-03","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/","summary":"Four journalists were charged under the Cybercrimes Act for corruption reporting, showing that scrutiny of elites could still trigger legal retaliation.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"4 Nigerian journalists charged with cybercrime, defamation over fraud investigation","publisher":"CPJ","date":"2024-02-09","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/02/4-nigerian-journalists-charged-with-cybercrime-defamation-over-fraud-investigation/","summary":"Journalists were arrested and charged after reporting on corruption at Kwara State Polytechnic, another concrete example of press intimidation rather than open access to information.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown","publisher":"Reuters via GPB","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown","summary":"Police detained Daniel Ojukwu under cybercrime law after a corruption story, which strongly suggests punishment of investigators.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House said the Cybercrimes Act remained a tool for legal pressure, intimidation, and self-censorship, even though there were no internet shutdowns. This is negative evidence for access to public information and protection of scrutiny.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Suspends Rural Electrification Agency Managing Director and Team from Office","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"2024-03-07","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-suspends-rural-electrification-agency-managing-director-and-team-from-office/","summary":"Tinubu suspended REA leadership after a fraud investigation and ordered a wider probe; this is negative evidence for the misconduct itself, but also positive evidence that he sometimes used formal processes against implicated officials.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria's Tinubu names seven ministers, sacks five in cabinet reshuffle","publisher":"Reuters via Yahoo News","date":"2024-10-23","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/nigerias-tinubu-names-seven-ministers-152818783.html","summary":"The cabinet reshuffle kept finance, defence, and planning in place and looks more like routine executive management than a purge tied to open loyalty testing, but it is only weak counterevidence.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.5","7B.8"]}]}
